notes: Automatic forward motion through an endless obstacle field scored on distance is Infinite Runner, but the genre's fork is lateral and this prompt has no lateral axis at all — the answer keeps the bird on a single vertical plane, so the shape is described rather than taken from the catalogue. lane-snap and lane-free both fork on side-to-side movement that does not exist here, and volume-open-air assumes surfaces to touch down on when touching anything ends the run; the axis bundle is a must-be-valid structure, since the gaps have to stay clearable as speed rises, over a volumetric play space. That volume is a single plane and so cannot self-occlude, which is why it routes on the genre's P6 with no CHECK. Free Runner's options carry across the substituted shape — chunk-modular for the endless queue, obstacle-jump for the gaps to fly through, hazard-kill for contact — plus marker-distance for the distance score, and the outer-space setting is dressing on the same geometry.
